name: Storybook · Install Storybook

description.zh: 最后开安装页。单条 CLI 就是能拿走的起步。 Storybook 是开源前端工坊，用于在隔离环境中构建、测试并文档化界面组件；核心仓库 MIT，安装命令为 npm create storybook@latest。顶栏 Visual Test 与 Enterprise 为另售产品。
description.en: Storybook 是开源前端工坊，用于在隔离环境中构建、测试并文档化界面组件；核心仓库 MIT，安装命令为 npm create storybook@latest。顶栏 Visual Test 与 Enterprise 为另售产品。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Storybook (https://storybook.js.org/).
Technology stack: javascript, typescript, react, vue.
Component specification: 最后开安装页。单条 CLI 就是能拿走的起步。

Visual details from source observation: 我们打开首页，大标题 Build, test & document components，旁边是 npm create storybook@latest。Docs 入门页把 Next.js、React、Vue、Angular 排成格子。安装页再给同一条 CLI。适合要在隔离环境里写组件的人。核心 MIT 免费；顶栏 Visual Test、Enterprise 是另售，别和这份工坊混成一回事。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: Core Storybook is MIT and free; Visual Test and Enterprise are separate paid products
